I am a master’s student in Social Data Analytics and Research at UT Dallas. Before that I worked in advertising and also created online content about gender issues. I am interested in digital platforms, algorithms, information behavior, and gender inequality in online spaces.

## Research Interests

- Digital platforms and algorithmic governance  
- Information behavior and content visibility  
- Gender inequality in digital spaces  
- Data-generating processes behind platform metrics
